yacl3.config.stfu:config.title: STFU
yacl3.config.stfu:config.maxChatHistory.desc: The maximum number of messages to keep in chat history.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.announceAdvancements.desc: If minecraft shows advancements achieved in chat.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.advancementToasts.desc: If minecraft shows advancements achieved as a toast.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.recipeToasts.desc: If minecraft shows a toast when you unlock new recipes.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.adminChat.desc: Whether you receive a message when an admin or command block runs a command.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.compactChat.desc: When you receive multiple equal chat messages, compact them into one.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableWidgetFade.desc: Disable the 2 seconds all buttons are invisible on the title screen after loading.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableFade.desc: Disable the 2 second fade animation when the game or resources (re)load.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableSplash.desc: Get rid of the reload overlays background whenever possible.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableLoadingTerrain.desc.1: Hide the loading terrain and reconfiguring screen to speed up world loading.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableLoadingTerrain.desc.2: This creates a small flicker and lag spike when loading.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.disableWorldAdvice.desc: Skip the warning screen for experimental settings and some datapacks.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.fixModelGaps.desc.1: Changes the item model generation code to prevent gaps.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.fixModelGaps.desc.2: Can cause issues on some devices.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.fixModelGaps.desc.3: Requires a reload to take effect.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.nightVisionFlicker.desc: When night vision runs out the entire world flickers for a few seconds, this allows you to disable this.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.animateTextures.desc: If you disable this blocks like the nether portal will stop animating.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.combineBars.desc: Combine the jump, experience and locator bars.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.deleteToTrash.desc: Tries to move worlds to the recycle bin instead of deleting them.
yacl3.config.stfu:config.renderThreadPriority.desc: Thread priority for rendering. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.serverThreadPriority.desc: Thread priority for the integrated server. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.ioThreadPriority.desc: Thread priority for IO and miscellaneous async operations. Warning: Bigger is not necessarily better!
yacl3.config.stfu:config.unfocusedVolume.desc: What to multiply the volume by when the window is not focused.
